product.name: Monoprice 14 Outlet Metal 1U Rackmount PDU Power Distribution Unit Surge Protector - 1050 Joules 6ft Cord
product.description: This Metal 1U Rackmount PDU Power Distribution Unit provides 14 surge protected NEMA® 5‑15 outlets, 6 on the front panel and 8 on the rear panel. It is designed to fit into a standard 19" equipment rack and is 1U high. It features 1050 joules of protection and is rated for 120 VAC, 12A/1440W. The heavy duty powder coated steel housing provides for a long lasting sturdy construction. Parallel circuitry enables it to continue functioning as a power strip after surge suppression is disabled by a surge or spike.
